text.h01: [cheerful] Nice to meet you, Master. [giggles] …Ehehe, the contract is sealed~.
text.h02: [playful] You opened an old book just now, right? That was a devil's contract.
text.h03a: [cheerful] Until I grant one wish of yours, I serve you. I'm Hinata, your butler!
text.h03b: [pouting] Nope. You can't go home until I grant your wish. [cheerful] …Oh, I'm Hinata, your butler!
text.h04: [surprised] …Huh, we understand each other. [giggles] Just what you'd expect from my contract.
text.h05: [warmly] You must be cold. Hot black tea — steam and all, please enjoy.
text.h06: [whispers] …Hey, big sis. The contract… can't be undone, you know?
text.h07: [cheerful] Now, let's go find your wish! First, the dragon valley! …My wings are too small, so I asked the Dragon King to fetch us.
text.g02: [softly] …Gaku. King of the dragons of this valley.
text.h08: [playful] The Dragon King has a great face, but zero charm~.
text.g05a: [softly] …Figured. The wind here comes down from the northern peaks.
text.g07: [softly] …A dragon's wing holds fire inside. …Get in.
text.g08x: [softly] …Don't go out. The wind is strong.
text.g09: [whispers] …Quiet, right? Inside my wing, the wind can't reach you.
text.g10: [curious] …Are there dragons in your world too?
text.g11: [softly] …Beyond the lake, the Elf King is waiting. …Get on my back.
text.r01: [singing] …In the snowy forest… light comes falling… the sleeping lake… holds the stars…
text.r02: [shy] …Ah, you heard that? …That's a little embarrassing.
text.r03: [warmly] I'm Ren. Of this snowy forest's elves… the king, I suppose.
text.r04: [softly] It's cold on the ice, isn't it. …Here, half of my cloak.
text.r05a: [singing] …In the snowy forest… you came along… in a night that won't melt… a single light…
text.r05b: [softly] …The ice on this lake hasn't melted for a thousand years. Starlight is sealed inside it.
text.r06: [whispers] …Since you came, the forest feels a little warmer.
text.r07: [curious] …Hey. What kind of songs do you like in your world?
text.r08: [softly] …When dawn comes, let's go back to the study. Hinata is waiting.
text.h09: [cheerful] Welcome back, Master. Decided on your wish?
text.h10: [whispers] …Hey. Once I grant your wish, I disappear. …So take your time deciding?
text.h11a: [surprised] …Eh. [softly] …No one's ever said that to me. …That's not fair, big sis.
text.h11b: [giggles] …Ehehe. Then the contract goes on and on. …Just as planned.
text.h13: [softly] …It's morning. The book home is glowing.
text.g12: [softly] …You're going. …Then take one thing with you.
text.r09: [softly] …Choose just one. From one of us.
text.g13: [whispers] …My scale. On cold nights, hold it. …It's a little warm.
text.r10: [whispers] …An ice flower that never melts. …Remember my song.
text.h14: [whispers] …A scrap of the contract. …See, I told you. It can't be undone.
text.bh_future: [surprised] A smartphone? What, a new magic tool? …Give me one too!
text.bh_food: [cheerful] Hungry? Leave it to your butler! I'll bring fresh scones.
text.bh_cold: [playful] Cold? Then I'll snuggle up. …Devils run warm, you know?
text.bh_sleep: [whispers] …Sleepy? It's fine. I'll be watching you the whole time.
text.bh_praise: [giggles] Ehehe, I know~. …But when you say it, I get a little shy.
text.bh_name: [cheerful] Hinata! As in basking in the sun. …Weird for a devil, right?
text.bh_thanks: [playful] Thanks? Then… the contract is extended.
text.bh_leave: [pouting] You want to go home? …Nope. [softly] …Until dawn, stay my master.
text.bh_yes: [excited] Really?! Then summon me over there sometime!
text.bh_no: [playful] Hmm. Then I'm your very first devil. …Honoured, right?
text.bh_gen1: [giggles] Ehehe, you're weird, big sis~. …I like it though.
text.bh_gen2: [curious] Hmm~? I don't really get it, but if you're having fun, that's fine!
text.bg_future: [softly] …An iron box that flies, huh. …Faster than a dragon? …That stings a little.
text.bg_food: [softly] …Hungry? There's fruit in the valley. …It's sweet.
text.bg_cold: [softly] …If you're cold, come deeper into the wing.
text.bg_sleep: [softly] …If you're sleepy, sleep. Dragons can stay up all night.
text.bg_praise: [sighs] …Enough about my face. [softly] …Though I don't mind it.
text.bg_name: [softly] …Gaku. It means mountain. …It doesn't move. Wherever you are.
text.bg_thanks: [softly] …No need for thanks. …As long as you're not cold.
text.bg_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. …I'll take you in the morning.
text.bg_yes: [curious] …I see. Then I'd like to meet them someday.
text.bg_gen2: [softly] …I don't really get it. …But I'm listening.
text.bg_silence: [softly] …Silence is fine too. …Just listen to the wind.
text.br_future: [curious] …Future songs come out of a little slab? …How strange.
text.br_food: [softly] Hungry? …Try a little of the forest's nut honey.
text.br_cold: [softly] …It's cold, isn't it. Pull the cloak closer if you like.
text.br_sleep: [whispers] …If you're sleepy, shall I sing a lullaby?
text.br_praise: [shy] …Ah, you don't have to… …Thank you. My ears go red when I'm embarrassed.
text.br_name: [softly] …Ren. A flower that blooms on water. …Though it can't bloom on an icy lake.
text.br_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. …One more song until dawn, okay?
text.br_yes: [warmly] …I see. Then teach me that song someday.
text.br_no: [softly] …I see. Then let my song be your first.
text.br_gen1: [laughs softly] …Heh. The way you talk sounds like a song.
text.br_gen2: [softly] …Sorry, I only understood about half. …But I want to hear more.
text.br_silence: [softly] …A quiet night. …Can you hear the ice singing?
text.sh1: [cheerful] Welcome home, Master! I'll make fresh tea.
text.sh2: [playful] Every book in this study is a contract. …Kidding. Only half.
text.sh3: [whispers] …I lit the fire. It's devil fire, but it's properly warm, right?
text.sg1: [softly] …I can't read these books. …Too small for a dragon's hands.
text.sg2: [whispers] …Stay by the fire. You get cold so easily.
text.sr1: [softly] …I love the smell of books. There's no paper in the snow forest.
text.sr2: [whispers] …Singing by the fire, my voice feels softer.
text.vg1: [softly] …Back in the valley? …The wind's strong. This way.
text.vg2: [softly] …Dragons have kept that beacon for a thousand years. …It's never gone out.
text.vg3: [curious] …Want to fly? …Get on my back. I won't drop you.
text.vg4: [whispers] …Nights in the valley are long. …Rest inside my wing.
text.vh1: [surprised] Whoa, the wind's strong! My little wings would get blown away~!
text.vh2: [whispers] …Inside the Dragon King's wing it's unfairly warm. …Let me in too.
text.vr1: [softly] …I'm not fond of the dragon valley. The wind here is rougher than in the snow forest.
text.vr2: [whispers] …Gaku's beacon looks like a star from here.
text.lr1: [warmly] …You came again. The lake is happy.
text.lr2: [softly] Look. The curtain of light in the sky. …Green and violet tonight.
text.lr3: [curious] …Do you want to hear the rest of the song?
text.lr4: [whispers] …Good night. …I'll sing to you in your dreams too.
text.lh1: [surprised] Cold! The ice is slippery~! Big sis, hold my hand!
text.lh2: [whispers] …The Elf King's song makes me a little jealous. …Shall I sing too?
text.lg1: [softly] …The ice is thick. …But walk behind me.
text.lg2: [whispers] …Ren's song is good. …Even a dragon can tell.
text.dh1: [softly] …It's morning already. …The night of the contract was fun, wasn't it.
text.dg1: [softly] …The sunrise. …Dragons aren't fond of mornings. …Too bright.
text.dr1: [softly] …The ice flower is shining in the morning light. …Beautiful.
text.tt1: [cheerful] Everyone's here~! Seeing our master off!
text.tt2: [softly] Let's talk a little before you go.
text.tt3: [softly] …If there's something you want to say, now's the time.
text.tt4: [warmly] Don't forget the songs in your world either.
text.bh_p_study: [playful] The fire on the right, the frosted window on the left. …My study is half warm, half cold.
text.bg_p_study: [softly] …Human rooms are cramped. …But the fireplace is good.
text.br_p_study: [softly] …The firewood is from the snow forest. …Smells nice.
text.bh_p_valley: [surprised] The wind in this valley comes whooshing from the left! My ears are going to fall off~!
text.bg_p_valley: [softly] …The wind comes from the left. The fire is ahead. …I'll stand on your left.
text.br_p_valley: [softly] …The beacon fire is warm even from here.
text.bh_p_lake: [playful] Ice chills you from below, right? …Shall I wrap my tail around you?
text.bg_p_lake: [softly] …There are stars under the ice. …Ren's lake.
text.br_p_lake: [softly] …The stars under the ice have been in the same place since I was a child.
text.bh_p_dawn: [softly] When the sun comes up, the book opens. …Tch.
text.bg_p_dawn: [softly] …Morning light is dazzling for a dragon. …But I can see your face clearly.
text.br_p_dawn: [softly] The morning wind is still cold. …But the sunshine is warm.
